chr_0037_minghe_ComboSkill.Name: Stars Shifted
chr_0037_minghe_ComboSkill.Desc:
COMBO TRIGGER: When an enemy becomes <#ba.noguard>Vulnerable</>.
Argent Flow wields his blade with lightning speed to unleash a multi-sequence attack that deals <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG</> to enemies along his path. When the final sequence scores a hit, it also applies <#ba.pulseinflict>Electric Infliction</>. Argent Flow's battle skill is then temporarily changed to <@ba.key>Bolt Rush</>.

chr_0037_minghe_NormalAttack.Name: Dust Resplendent
chr_0037_minghe_NormalAttack.Desc:
BASIC ATTACK: 
An attack with up to 5 sequences that deals <@ba.pd>Physical DMG</>. As the controlled operator, <#ba.lastcombo>Final Strike</> also deals <@ba.poise>23</> Stagger. 

DIVE ATTACK: 
Basic attack performed in mid-air becomes a dive attack that deals <@ba.pd>Physical DMG</> to nearby enemies. 

FINISHER: 
Basic attack performed near a Staggered enemy becomes a finisher attack that deals massive <@ba.pd>Physical DMG</> and recovers some SP.

chr_0037_minghe_NormalSkill.Name: Darkness Cowed
chr_0037_minghe_NormalSkill.Desc:
Argent Flow sweeps his lance and deals <@ba.pd>Physical DMG</> to nearby enemies and applies <#ba.airborne>Lift</> to target(s) in front of him.
After Argent Flow casts his combo skill, his battle skill is temporarily changed to <@ba.key>Bolt Rush</>.
<@ba.key>Bolt Rush</>: Argent Flow mounts his galloper Nuli to leap into mid-air, powers up quickly, and then charges at the target to forcibly apply <#ba.conduct>Electrification</> and deal <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG</> to enemies within a large area in front of him. When this <#ba.conduct>Electrification</> is applied on a target with <#ba.pulseinflict>Electric Infliction</>, it <#ba.consume>consumes</> all <#ba.pulseinflict>Electric Infliction</> stacks from the target and grants <#ba.conduct>Electrification</> <#ba.statuslevel>Status Level +1</> per 1 stack consumed. After <#ba.consume>consuming</> the target's <#ba.pulseinflict>Electric Infliction</>, Argent Flow also applies 1 stack of <#ba.noguard>Vulnerability</>.

chr_0037_minghe_UltimateSkill.Name: Heavens Sundered
chr_0037_minghe_UltimateSkill.Desc:
Argent Flow mounts Nuli and charges with his lance, dealing continuous <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG</> to targets in front of him while impaling and carrying weak enemies before him throughout the charge. After the charge ends, Argent Flow leaps into the air and unleashes a Cleansing Cleave at the ground. The slash deals <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG</> and applies 1 stack of <#ba.pulseinflict>Electric Infliction</>. Argent Flow then pierces the ground with his lance, applying <#ba.crush>Crush</> and dealing <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG</> to enemies within a large area.
<@ba.info>If Argent Flow's ultimate charges into a non-weak enemy (that cannot be impaled and pushed), his charge will end early.</>

chr_0037_minghe_passive_skill_0_1.Name: Zenith of Voltmancy
chr_0037_minghe_passive_skill_0_1.Desc:
When Argent Flow applies <#ba.conduct>Electrification</>, this <#ba.conduct>Electrification</> also increases all types of DMG Taken of the target for the same duration, and he also applies <@ba.key>Sunderization</> stack(s) on the target, the number of stacks is equal to the <#ba.conduct>Electrification</> <#ba.statuslevel>Status Level</> and maxes out at 12. <@ba.key>Sunderization</> lasts for 60s.
When dealing <#ba.crush>Crush DMG</> to a target with <@ba.key>Sunderization</>, this <#ba.crush>Crush DMG</> is increased to <@ba.vup>1.2</> times the original and detonates all <@ba.key>Sunderization</> stacks. The explosion deals <@ba.vup>[Number of Sunderization stacks × 220% ATK]</> of <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG</> to the target and 40% of that DMG to other enemies near the said target.
<@ba.info>When the explosion DMG of Sunderization is dealt to another enemy with Sunderization, it also detonates all Sunderization stacks of that enemy.</>

chr_0037_minghe_passive_skill_0_2.Desc:
When Argent Flow applies <#ba.conduct>Electrification</>, this <#ba.conduct>Electrification</> also increases all types of DMG Taken of the target for the same duration, and he also applies <@ba.key>Sunderization</> stack(s) on the target, the number of stacks is equal to the <#ba.conduct>Electrification</> <#ba.statuslevel>Status Level</> and maxes out at 12. <@ba.key>Sunderization</> lasts for 60s.
When dealing <#ba.crush>Crush DMG</> to a target with <@ba.key>Sunderization</>, this <#ba.crush>Crush DMG</> is increased to <@ba.vup>1.2</> times the original and detonates all <@ba.key>Sunderization</> stacks. The explosion deals <@ba.vup>[Number of Sunderization stacks × 330% ATK]</> of <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG</> to the target and 40% of that DMG to other enemies near the said target.
<@ba.info>When the explosion DMG of Sunderization is dealt to another enemy with Sunderization, it also detonates all Sunderization stacks of that enemy.</>

For every point of Arts Intensity that Argent Flow has, increase <@ba.key>Sunderization</> explosion DMG by another <@ba.vup>0.4%</>.
